old: These functions can be assigned to a planner, worker and critic.
new: These functions can be distributed among a planner, worker and critic.
reason: Uses the natural verb for dividing responsibilities and matches the Russian source.

old: We investigate whether fewer calls can retain these functions while leaving correctness checks to external tests.
new: We investigate whether fewer calls can retain these functions while leaving correctness checking to external tests.
reason: Makes the object of checking a process rather than a countable set of checks.

old: It separates obtaining a program from the model from checking its correctness.
new: It separates program generation from correctness checking.
reason: Removes the awkward double from-construction while preserving the generation/evaluation boundary.

old: Its retained package comparison changed these mechanisms together with call topology, so it cannot identify the contribution of internal roles.
new: Its retained package-level comparison changed these mechanisms together with call topology, so it cannot identify the contribution of internal roles.
reason: Package-level makes clear that the comparison concerns whole configurations.

old: Each condition receives the same supplied task/context and the same subsequent evaluator.
new: Each condition receives the same supplied task and context and undergoes the same subsequent evaluation.
reason: Improves parallel structure and avoids the compressed task/context compound.

old: A linguistic assertion that the solution is correct cannot replace those tests.
new: A textual claim that the solution is correct cannot replace those tests.
reason: Textual claim is more idiomatic and accessible scientific English than linguistic assertion.

old: For an execution protocol $a$, the engineering objective is to increase the probability of verified success while controlling expected token consumption and inference valuation.
new: For an execution protocol $a$, the engineering objective is to increase the probability of verified success while controlling expected token use and generation valuation.
reason: Uses plain, parallel terms and follows the source's reference to the monetary valuation of generation.

old: The word \emph{hybrid} refers to this combination of internal instructions and external executable evidence.
new: Here, \emph{hybrid} denotes this combination of internal instructions and external executable evidence.
reason: More direct sentence opening and a precise definition of the term.

old: There is no externally observed sequence of hidden plans or critic scores.
new: No sequence of hidden plans or critic scores is observed externally.
reason: Active, compact phrasing keeps the observability caveat prominent.

old: The exposed execution state is $\sigma_j=(x,\mathcal{C}_0,a,j,\mathcal{H}_j)$, where $a$ fixes the assigned condition, $j$ is the call index and $\mathcal{H}_j$ contains all complete preceding exposed responses.
new: The observable execution state is $\sigma_j=(x,\mathcal{C}_0,a,j,\mathcal{H}_j)$, where $a$ fixes the assigned condition, $j$ is the call index and $\mathcal{H}_j$ contains all complete preceding exposed responses.
reason: Observable is the standard term for the state available to the audit and matches the Russian wording.

old: The model configuration is fixed within the comparison.
new: The model configuration is held fixed throughout the comparison.
reason: Makes the constancy claim explicit and idiomatic.

old: The direct comparator receives only the implementation instruction and that contract.
new: The direct comparator receives only the implementation instruction and the same output contract.
reason: Clarifies the referent of that contract and preserves the controlled-protocol meaning.

old: The latter are 200 independent sampling units at most, not 1,000 independent tasks.
new: At most, the latter are 200 independent sampling units, not 1,000 independent tasks.
reason: Places the scope qualifier before the subject for easier reading.

old: It cannot establish that the model executed separate internal roles: checkpoint compliance and private computation remain unobserved.
new: It cannot establish that the model executed separate internal roles because checkpoint compliance and private computation remain unobserved.
reason: Replaces the colon with an explicit causal link for smoother prose.

old: These wide intervals neither establish equivalence nor exclude a meaningful quality effect.
new: These wide intervals neither establish equivalence nor rule out a meaningful quality effect.
reason: Rule out is the more idiomatic collocation for interval-based inference.

old: The completed table therefore combines two original candidates and eight extension candidates under different operational deadlines; it is not a homogeneous first-attempt estimate.
new: The completed table therefore combines two original candidates and eight extension candidates generated under different operational deadlines; it is not a homogeneous first-attempt estimate.
reason: States directly what the deadlines modify: candidate generation.

old: The evidence therefore supports examining a compact internal configuration, while leaving the necessity of its role structure unproven.
new: The evidence therefore supports examining a compact internal configuration, while leaving the necessity of its role structure unresolved.
reason: Unresolved is more neutral and natural for an empirical question that remains open.

old: Available-pair inference is about the observed eligible subset.
new: Inference from available pairs concerns the observed eligible subset.
reason: Removes a compressed nominal phrase and makes the inferential scope explicit.

old: No externally justified quality-loss margin or joint quality--cost criterion supports a non-inferiority or economic-superiority decision.
new: No externally justified quality-loss margin or joint quality--cost criterion supports a decision about non-inferiority or economic superiority.
reason: Improves readability while preserving both methodological caveats.
